'''Prakess''' was a<ref name="Wizards" /> tiny<ref name="DoE">''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]''</ref> terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Prakith system/Legends|Prakith system]], located in the [[Deep Core]]'s<ref name="Wizards" /> [[Sector 5/Legends|Sector 5]].<ref name="SOL" /> It occupied the fifth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around the star [[Prak]] and had two [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. Prakess featured a [[Temperature/Legends|frozen]] environment and a rocky surface.<ref name="Wizards" />

==Behind the scenes==
Prakess was first mentioned in "[[Byss and the Deep Core]], Part 3: Prakith," the third entry in the [[Planet Hoppers]] ''[[Byss and the Deep Core]]'' article series, written by [[Rodney Thompson]] and published on [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s [[Wizards.com|website]] on [[April 21]], [[2005]].<ref name="Wizards" /> The planet then made a full appearance in ''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]'', the final novel of the ''[[Star Wars: Darth Bane Trilogy]]'' written by [[Drew Karpyshyn]]<ref name="DoE" /> and published on [[December 8]], 2009.<ref name="SWBU">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/news20090219.html|text=Book Update: ''Deathtroopers'' and Darth Bane}}</ref> The reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'',<ref name="TEA" /> published on [[August 18]], [[2009]],<ref name="YBY">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> placed the Prakith [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Prakess, in grid square K-10.<ref name="TEA" />
